title: Relay common definitions
description: Shared building blocks of oaiy-relay/1 (README sections 4.1 and 4.2). This file validates nothing by itself: every other schema points into its `$defs`. Patterns are the wire contract for identifiers; length limits given in bytes elsewhere in the README (a header of at most 512 bytes, a body of at most the lane cap) are checked by code because JSON Schema counts characters, and a character count is never larger than a byte count, so a `maxLength` here is a safe lower bound on the byte rule and never a looser one.

b64u.description: base64url without padding (RFC 4648 section 5). Padding, whitespace and characters outside the alphabet are refused.

b64u8.description: base64url of 8 bytes (11 characters): a token id, an enrolment key id, an epoch.

b64u16.description: base64url of 16 bytes (22 characters): a pid, a rid, the random part of a device id.

key32.description: base64url of 32 bytes (43 characters): a public key, a thumbprint, a SHA-256 or HMAC-SHA-256 output.

thumbprint.description: b64u(SHA-256 of the canonical JWK {"crv":"Ed25519","kty":"OKP","x":"<b64u>"}), 43 characters.

signature.description: base64url of a 64-byte Ed25519 signature (86 characters).

deviceId.description: dev- plus 22 characters. The only form a desktop or the provider may put into a URL or a capability.

principalId.description: A device id or a provider id.

pid.description: Pairing rendezvous id: b64u of 16 bytes (HKDF of the pairing secret).

rid.description: Reply box id: b64u of 16 bytes chosen by the browser.

itemId.description: Item id chosen by the sender. Unique per (mailbox, lane) while the relay remembers it.

appId.description: App or plugin id, at most 64 characters (narrowed from Aokie's 200 so a party mailbox name fits a 255 byte indexed column).

token.description: Device capability token, always 63 characters. The pattern is necessary, not sufficient: the last character of each part must also be canonical (its unused low bits zero), which only code can check.

epoch.description: Relay epoch: b64u of 8 random bytes.

kid.description: Enrolment key id: b64u of 8 bytes.

seq.description: Per-mailbox sequence number. The first item of a mailbox has seq 1; gaps are allowed.

lane.description: The lanes a relay serves. flow, flow.in and flow.out are reserved and not served in v1.

grant.description: A phone grant such as state_read or caller_read.

origin.description: An https origin: scheme, host and optional port, no path.

publicUrl.description: A relay base URL: https, path-free, no trailing slash, no userinfo, query or fragment.

inboxAddress.description: Where a POST /v1/items item may go: a device inbox or a reply box.

mailbox.description: Any mailbox address. The app: forms exist only behind the Aokie compatibility routes.

from.description: Sender hint: a device or provider id, rbx:<rid>, or relay. Routing information, never authority.

eph.description: For tunnel1: the browser's ephemeral public key, standard base64 with padding, 44 characters.

kid.description: An id of at most 64 characters.

sig.description: b64u of an Ed25519 signature, at most 88 characters; used on ring items.

hdr.description: Routing header. Keys outside this list are invalid_item. The serialised form (compact JSON, unescaped slashes and unicode, UTF-8) is at most 512 bytes; that is a byte limit and is checked by code.

jws.description: JWS Compact Serialization: exactly two dots.

etag.description: Slot ETag: a quoted b64u of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(body || 0x00 || ct).

typedCode.description: Typed pairing code: 28 Crockford base32 characters in seven groups. The two check characters are verified by code.

sasCode.description: The 13 character short authentication string as shown, grouped XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-C.

pairingUri.description: Pairing key. Parameter order is the canonical writer order; a reader accepts any order and ignores unknown parameters (README section 4.10.2).

endpointPublicKey.description: EndpointPublicKey as the Aokie protocol writes it.
